title: Storage alert rules in the core
goal: The core computes which storage alerts are open at a given time, with NERV's timing
acceptance: The F-005 core computes open storage alerts for each battery not stored or retired: 21:00 local the same day (the next day once 21:00 has passed), then after 5 days at 21:00, then daily at 21:00, cleared once the battery is stored or retired; timezone-aware; the schedule state persists through the core's storage
Specs carried over or rewritten from NERV's test/battery-storage-reminders.test.ts with invented data cover each stage, the past-21:00 case, a DST change and the clear
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a 136-line NERV module and its test, moved from reminder rows to computed alerts. Not a measurement.
